scope: Isolated build 10 boundary and eight-turn development checks; no shipping approval, no new models

boundarySuite.negativeAdmission: Native Mac check with the same runtime: 1922+128 must reject a 2048 context; 3977+128 must reject a 4096 context before generation. No truncation.

longChatSuite.history: All actual generated prior assistant responses and user updates, with publisher-subset role framing. No history truncation or summaries.
longChatSuite.quality: Each turn should preserve latest updates. Review exact final facts, no stale values or invented specifics. No success percentage inferred beyond these development prompts.

unchangedSafeguards: serious/critical thermal start refusal and cancellation
resourceAcceptance: Every intended answer completed, sampled footprint below 1.5 GiB, no memory-warning or thermal stop, thermal states below serious. Any failure ends that suite without automatic retry.
battery: USB-connected tests are not battery-drain evidence. Dedicated unplugged testing and appropriate measurement design remain separate.
historyOfFailure: Earlier back-to-back thermal failure remains a failed result regardless of these paced outcomes. Start only after checking current readiness.
